title: JailMod
description: A server-side jail management mod for Fabric 1.20.1. Jail players with reasons and durations, similar to EssentialsX. Features LuckPerms integration, tab suggestions, and anti-escape system.
body:
# JailMod
A server-side jail management mod for Fabric 1.20.1, similar to EssentialsX jail feature.

## Features
### 🚔 Jail System
/setjail - Set the jail location

/deljail - Remove the jail location

/jail <player> <reason> [duration] - Jail a player

/unjail <player> - Release a player

/jailinfo [player] - View jail information

/jaillist - List all jailed players

/jailreload - Reload configuration

## ⏱️ Duration Support
30s - 30 seconds
10m - 10 minutes
1h - 1 hour
1d - 1 day
permanent - Permanent jail
## 🎯 Tab Suggestions
Suggested durations: 5m, 10m, 30m, 1h, 2h, 6h, 12h, 24h, 1d, 3d, 7d, 14d, 30d
Suggested reasons: Griefing, Stealing, Harassment, Spamming, Exploiting
Fully customizable in config!
## 🔒 Restrictions for Jailed Players
❌ Cannot interact with blocks

❌ Cannot use items

❌ Cannot attack

❌ Cannot use ANY commands

❌ Cannot chat

❌ Cannot escape (auto-teleport back if too far)

❌ Cannot change dimensions

## 🏃 Anti-Escape System
Auto-teleport if player moves more than 5 blocks from jail
Blocks dimension changes (Nether, End, modded dimensions)
Real-time monitoring every tick
## 📍 Teleport Back on Release
Players are automatically teleported to their previous location when released
Works for /unjail and automatic expiration
## 🔑 LuckPerms Integration
Full permission support
Falls back to OP system if LuckPerms is not installed
